scholarships.title: ICSSR Financial Assistance for Data Collection Abroad
scholarships.degree: Doctoral, Postdoctoral, Research (faculty and Ph.D/PDF scholars)
scholarships.official_source: Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), Ministry of Education, Government of India

existing.description: The ICSSR provides financial assistance to Indian social science scholars who need to travel abroad for data collection or to consult archival material in connection with their research. It is aimed at scholars who proposed fieldwork abroad in their original approved ICSSR fellowship or project proposal and have made substantial progress, or at independent scholars for whom data collection abroad is academically justified and the research is at an advance stage. The total expenditure on the foreign visit, including economy class airfare, visa fee, travel insurance, local conveyance and maintenance, is supported within the prescribed norms of Government notifications.
eligibility: Serving Indian Faculty members in ICSSR research institute/ICSSR recognized institutes/institutions of national importance as defined by the Ministry of Education/university/deemed university/colleges recognized by the UGC and having 12b status with Ph.D degree are eligible to apply.
Ph.D/PDF Indian scholars are also eligible to apply.
existing.eligibility_summary: Serving Indian faculty members with a PhD in an ICSSR research institute, ICSSR recognised institute, institution of national importance as defined by the Ministry of Education, UGC-recognized university/deemed university/college with 12(b) status, and Indian Ph.D/PDF scholars.
benefits: The sanctioned maintenance amount is released before the commencement of the visit on submission of the copy of passport, visa procured, ticket and an undertaking.

Where the scholar receives air fare from any other source, 75 percent of the maintenance grant is given in advance and the remaining 25 percent after satisfactory submission of the relevant documents including the Statement of Expenditure.
coverage: Maintenance for the period of the visit
Total expenditure on the foreign visit within the prescribed norms as specified by the notifications of the Government
requirements: Data collection abroad must have been proposed in the scholar's original approved ICSSR fellowship or project proposal, with substantial progress in the research, or be academically justified for research at an advance stage.
The visit must be realistic and not more than of two weeks duration.
After submitting the online application, a hard copy of the same along with all enclosures must be sent to the In-charge, IC Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067.
Expenditure is reimbursed on submission of the statement of expenditure and the full documentary set; the ICSSR may ask for a copy of the tickets booked and the visa obtained before departure.
Where air fare is received from another source, only 75 percent of the maintenance grant is released in advance and the balance after the statement of expenditure is submitted.
ICSSR funding must be duly acknowledged in any publication (monograph or book) brought out from the material collected under the scheme, with a copy sent to ICSSR.
documents: Online application submitted through the ICSSR applicant portal at https://app.icssr.org/
Hard copy of the application along with all enclosures, sent to: In-charge, IC Division, Indian Council of Social Science Research, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067
Statement of expenditure indicating air ticket costs, visa fees, insurance charges, hotel bills, purchase of foreign currency bill and local airport transfers
Photocopy of passport and immigration stamped paper
Detailed report on the work done related to the research
Publication (monograph or book) from the material collected, with a copy to ICSSR, where applicable
application_method: Submit the online application through the ICSSR applicant portal at https://app.icssr.org/ - applications are received throughout the year.
Send a hard copy of the application along with all enclosures to the In-charge, IC Division, ICSSR, Aruna Asaf Ali Marg, New Delhi 110067.
Before departure, submit the copy of passport, visa procured, ticket and an undertaking to obtain release of the sanctioned maintenance amount.
After the visit, submit the statement of expenditure with all supporting documents including original boarding pass and the detailed research report for reimbursement or release of the balance.
existing.selection_notes: Not published on the scheme page. The scheme page states the eligibility conditions and the objective of assisting scholars who have proposed fieldwork abroad in their original approved fellowship or project proposal and made substantial progress, or independent scholars whose research is at an advance stage; the evaluation and sanction procedure is not spelled out on the page and is listed under institution_check_required.
existing.best_fit: Indian social science faculty, Ph.D holders and PDF scholars at an advanced stage of research who need a short (up to two-week) funded research visit abroad to collect data or consult archival material.
existing.notes: Not deferrable and not renewable: this is a single research visit capped at two weeks, not a tenure. No must-return-home rule is published because the award funds a short research visit, not a degree. Post-award: expenditure is reimbursed on submission of the statement of expenditure with air ticket costs, visa fees, insurance charges, hotel bills, purchase of foreign currency bill, local airport transfers, photocopy of passport, immigration stamped paper, original boarding pass and a detailed report on the work done. The ICSSR may ask for a copy of the tickets booked and the visa obtained before departure. ICSSR funding must be acknowledged in any publication or monograph brought out from the material collected.
existing.duration: The visit under this Scheme should be realistic and not more than of two weeks duration
existing.application_period: Rolling - applications are received online throughout the year.
existing.deadline_display: Applications are received online throughout the year.
